name: JARVIS Brain
description: Inspect and tune the local Ollama brain without bypassing JARVIS safety policy.
progressive_guidance: Use getStatus before diagnosing slowness. Use benchmark to measure real local token speed. ECO uses Qwen 4B/32 iterations, NORMAL Qwen 4B/64, BOOST Qwen 9B/96. setMode, setModel and unloadModel require one-time owner approval. If a requested model is not installed, report the exact ollama pull command instead of downloading it silently.

getStatus.description: Return current JARVIS model, low-resource mode, RAM/VRAM and Ollama loaded/installed model state.

benchmark.description: Benchmark local Ollama generation speed for the active or selected supported model.

setMode.description: Switch JARVIS to ECO, NORMAL or BOOST. Requires one-time owner approval.

setModel.description: Switch the unified JARVIS Ollama model between Qwen 4B and Qwen 9B. Requires one-time owner approval.

unloadModel.description: Unload the active or selected Ollama model from memory/VRAM. Requires one-time owner approval.
